test_AseDBDataset: test the AseDBDataset class by creating datasets from ASE database files with energy and force arguments
test_AseReadDataset: test the AseReadDataset class by reading CIF structure files from a directory with glob patterns
test_AseReadMultiStructureDataset: test the AseReadMultiStructureDataset class by loading multi-structure trajectory files with relaxed energy support
test_ase_dataset_get_atoms: test the get_atoms method on ASE datasets to retrieve atom objects with sid metadata
test_empty_dataset_error: test that AseDBDataset and AseReadMultiStructureDataset raise ValueError when initialized with an empty source directory
